cohort: 22,346 births from before the pandemic (January 2018-February 2020) and 18,597 births during the pandemic (March 2020-December 2021)
finding: Both emergency and elective caesarean section rates increased significantly during the COVID-19 pandemic, with a higher rate of increase for emergency caesarean sections.
mod_finding: Emergency and elective caesarean section rates increased significantly during the COVID-19 pandemic.
